column1: # ZKas pinned anchor->source mappings (complete landmine set).
# Each line: a shielded tree root a CANONICAL block produces, which the chain's
# anchor index resolves to a NON-canonical block. The chain drops spends against
# these; a fresh sync keeps them and wedges forever. Pinning aligns the two.
# NEVER bulk-pin a full index dump: the index is time-dependent and a snapshot
# applied retroactively drops spends the chain kept (observed: shielded state
# diverged at DAA 477,656 under an 89,491-entry bulk pin).
